identity: host authenticated company and registered instance; never browser supplied tenant_id
layout: one registered Agent item with entry/configuration states in one native host card; preserve unsaved inputs on tab changes
prohibited_host_writes: overview content or cards other than this Agent
security: no remote HTML, script or iframe
mount only the Agent root and its namespaced routes
CAS on settings, knowledge and tasks
data_scope: one instance per company; external SQLite requires its own backup coverage
